host: Apple M4 Pro laptop, 24 GB unified memory (25.77 GB as reported by the driver), macOS 26.6.2
gpu: Apple Silicon GPU (arm64), Metal via torch 2.14.0 MPS, memory shared with the system
probe_source_caveat: The hash is of scripts/timing_probe.py in this tree at the recorded commit, unchanged since b76645b. The node was given a copy of that file and the copy was not re-hashed there, so provenance rests on the transfer rather than on a check.
command: ./run-probe.sh with no arguments, which the bootstrap had expanded to: --models tabpfn --context-sizes 10000,50000,100000 --test-rows 5000,20000 --out probe.json
console_log_withheld: The console log is not recorded here. Every traceback in it carries the node owner's account name in a home path, which may not reach a file that goes public. The JSON was checked for that and for any token before being copied in; it holds neither.
question_this_run_was_sent_to_answer: Whether an Apple machine can carry the study's TabPFN passes at a 50,000-row context against a 20,000-row scoring batch, so that no GPU has to be rented, and what one scored row costs there. The scoring-batch term was the half of the question the M3 run had left open.

derived.how: (319.537 - 257.369) / 15000, the two 50,000-row rows differing only in scored rows.
derived.how_fixed: 257.369 - 5000 * 0.00416: what remains once the scored rows are priced out, dominated by the context.

the_100000_row_failure: AcceleratorError: index 893 is out of bounds for dimension with size 160, raised inside a Metal kernel. Not a memory failure: the 50,000-row context peaked at 3.6 GB on a 24 GB machine. The study caps context at 50,000 rows, so this is recorded and not pursued.
how_tabpfn_ran_without_a_licence_token: The checkpoint was sent to the node as a file with the two scripts and placed in TABPFN_MODEL_CACHE_DIR by the bootstrap. In tabpfn 8.5.0 the licence check, ensure_license_accepted, is called only from _download_model, which runs only when the checkpoint is absent from that directory. No connection to the licence server was opened.

preceding_attempts_on_the_same_machine.packages_then: tabicl 2.2.0 from an unpinned install with checkpoint tabicl-classifier-v2-20260212; tabpfn 8.5.0; torch 2.14.0
preceding_attempts_on_the_same_machine.tabicl: MPS backend out of memory at the smallest probed shape, 10,000 context against 5,000 scored, after a successful warm-up: MPS allocated 3.76 GiB, other allocations 25.98 GiB, max allowed 30.19 GiB, while trying to allocate 504 MiB. The sweep stopped the context climb there, as designed.
preceding_attempts_on_the_same_machine.tabpfn: TabPFNLicenseError twice: the TLS handshake to the licence verification endpoint timed out after 10 seconds. The token was never evaluated. The same failure had occurred from a second, unrelated network earlier.
preceding_attempts_on_the_same_machine.caveat: TabICL was not retried after the install was pinned to 2.1.1, the version the T4 probes recorded. The finding that TabICL does not fit a 24 GB Apple machine at a 10,000-row context therefore rests on 2.2.0 alone.
